result.reason: The clause adopts the preferred mutual cap amount, but it does not operatively identify the Excluded Claims; the margin comment’s assertion that they appear in Section 21.3 cannot cure the supplied language. It also omits the mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and the clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages. Accordingly, neither the preferred position nor the fallback’s required carve-outs is established. The revision is otherwise concise and preserves the clause’s general commercial structure, although “total aggregate liability” is redundant.
